From 0a3bd5018ad72b6e9e4ea86755f8e4ecdc755ba0 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: magnum <john.magnum@hushmail.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Dec 2017 11:47:21 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] Bug fix for SAP-G format, problem introduced in 27c9bf17.
 SIMD_COEF_32 was tested before defined. Also down-tunes OMP_SCALE so it
 resembles the multiplier used for length sorting. Closes #3050.


diff --git a/src/sapG_fmt_plug.c b/src/sapG_fmt_plug.c
index f7e897106..77d0c87d2 100644
--- a/src/sapG_fmt_plug.c
+++ b/src/sapG_fmt_plug.c
@@ -25,15 +25,6 @@ john_register_one(&fmt_sapG);
 
 #if defined(_OPENMP)
 #include <omp.h>
-#ifndef OMP_SCALE
-#if defined (SIMD_COEF_32)
-// Some OMP scaling moved into max_keys, so that we can have more values in SIMD
-// mode, to sort hashes by limb size.  (TODO)
-#define OMP_SCALE               128
-#else
-#define OMP_SCALE               2048
-#endif
-#endif
 #endif
 
 #include "arch.h"
@@ -50,6 +41,14 @@ john_register_one(&fmt_sapG);
 #include "johnswap.h"
 #include "memdbg.h"
 
+#ifndef OMP_SCALE
+#if defined (SIMD_COEF_32)
+#define OMP_SCALE               32
+#else
+#define OMP_SCALE               2048
+#endif
+#endif
+
 #define FORMAT_LABEL            "sapg"
 #define FORMAT_NAME             "SAP CODVN F/G (PASSCODE)"
 #define ALGORITHM_NAME          "SHA1 " SHA1_ALGORITHM_NAME
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `src/sapG_fmt_plug.c`**
   - Removed the previous definition of `OMP_SCALE` that was set to 128 for the case when `SIMD_COEF_32` is defined, and 2048 otherwise.
   - Introduced a new definition of `OMP_SCALE` where it is now set to 32 when `SIMD_COEF_32` is defined, and remains 2048 otherwise.

### Relationships Between Modifications
The modifications in `src/sapG_fmt_plug.c` address a bug related to the incorrect testing of `SIMD_COEF_32` before its definition. By adjusting the value of `OMP_SCALE`, the patch aims to down-tune the OpenMP scaling factor to better align with the multiplier used for length sorting, thereby resolving the issue introduced in a previous commit (27c9bf17). This change is intended to improve the performance and correctness of the SAP-G format handling in the code.

Here is the commit message:
Bug fix for SAP-G format, problem introduced in 27c9bf17.
 SIMD_COEF_32 was tested before defined. Also down-tunes OMP_SCALE so it
 resembles the multiplier used for length sorting. Closes #3050.

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the incorrect definition and testing of the `OMP_SCALE` variable, which was set to a higher value (128) when `SIMD_COEF_32` was defined, instead of a more appropriate lower value (32). This misconfiguration likely led to performance issues and incorrect behavior in the SAP-G format processing, particularly in relation to OpenMP scaling and length sorting.

Here is the patch:
 #if defined(_OPENMP)
 #include <omp.h>
-#ifndef OMP_SCALE
-#if defined (SIMD_COEF_32)
-// Some OMP scaling moved into max_keys, so that we can have more values in SIMD
-// mode, to sort hashes by limb size.  (TODO)
-#define OMP_SCALE               128
-#else
-#define OMP_SCALE               2048
-#endif
-#endif
 #endif
 
 #include "memdbg.h"
 
+#ifndef OMP_SCALE
+#if defined (SIMD_COEF_32)
+#define OMP_SCALE               32
+#else
+#define OMP_SCALE               2048
+#endif
+#endif
+
 #define FORMAT_LABEL            "sapg"
 #define FORMAT_NAME             "SAP CODVN F/G (PASSCODE)"
